blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Saturday questioned the motives of three minority senators who voted in favor of reconsidering a petition seeking to unseat Sen. Erwin Tulfo, saying their decision undermined justice and fairness. In a post on X, Lacson criticized the three senator-members of the Senate Electoral Tribunal (SET) who supported a motion for reconsideration filed by disbarred lawyer Berteni Causing, which he said was filed beyond the deadline by a petitioner without legal standing. “Justice and fairness went out of the window when three minority senator-members voted in favor of an out-of-time motion for reconsideration filed […]...
